General Fund detail is from the budget-and-actual schedule (p9-13) with no object breakdown (not itemized); the General Fund combining schedule (p7-8) is not recorded, to avoid double counting. Group-level budget amounts printed on heading rows (e.g. Support services - student 1,550,000) are not recorded as line budgets; 'Other' budget-only line 2,432,543 and other lines with budget but blank actual are skipped.
